document: Passport of a citizen of Turkmenistan

routes.label: at the internal affairs authority: within seven working days

note: The internal passport. The President's decree on improving the system of internal passports, as the Embassy of Turkmenistan publishes it, gives the internal affairs authority the drawing-up and issue of the passport and has the Ministry of Internal Affairs issue it within seven working days. Its fee, the age from which it is issued and its term weren't found in any source read, so every age is offered and fee and term are null.

sources.title: Embassy of Turkmenistan in Afghanistan, President Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov signs decree on improvement of system of internal passports in Turkmenistan
sources.said: The internal affairs authority of Turkmenistan to ensure drawing-up and issuing passports to citizens of Turkmenistan, their residence registration, termination of registration. ... 1) to register and issue a passport of a citizen of Turkmenistan within seven working days in a solemn atmosphere;
